run_robustness_test: run a detector robustness test on a config and checkpoint with specified corruptions and severities
run_coco_evaluation: run COCO evaluation on detection result JSON files and return AP and AR metrics
run_voc_evaluation: run PASCAL VOC evaluation on detection results and return mean AP for each class
test_detector_with_corruptions: test an MMDetection model against image corruptions like noise, blur, weather, and digital artifacts
evaluate_robustness_benchmark: evaluate model robustness using the ImageNet-C corruption benchmark and print mPC or rPC metrics
